title: POINT I/O
summary: Modular distributed I/O connected over EtherNet/IP through an adapter.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: An adapter module connects a row of small I/O modules to EtherNet/IP. The controller owns the connection and receives the I/O data cyclically.

sections.heading: In PLC Lab
sections.body: No simulation profile, and EtherNet/IP is not simulated. Distributed I/O with configured versus installed modules is practiced on the generic rack in the Hardware tab. **CONCEPTUAL**.
